data.description: The laws of physics may say it's near impossible to fly on Mars, but actually flying a heavier-than-air vehicle on the Red Planet is much harder than that. NASA’s Mars 2020 mission will deliver a technology demonstration that will put the idea to the test -- a helicopter that will perform controlled flight on Mars.   For more about NASA's Mars missions, visit https://nasa.gov/mars and https://mars.nasa.gov
data.description_508: NASA’s Mars 2020 mission will carry a helicopter that will perform controlled flight on Mars.
